You keep the decision record of a new mobile release process. Decisions and their reasons change, the user sets and lifts constraints, and open questions get answers or stay open.

Initial specification:
- [e001] In the design meeting, the group chose `circleci-mac`, and Gus recorded it as the decision on the mobile CI service.

- [e003] After the trial results, Kira wrote in the decision log that the decision on the code signing method is `fastlane-match`.
- [e004] After the trial results, Mei wrote in the decision log that the decision on the beta channel is `appcenter-beta`.
- [e005] The architecture review approved `flagsmith-oss` as the decision on the feature flag service, as Tove noted in the minutes.
- [e006] In the design meeting, the group chose `20`, and Kira recorded it as the decision on the first rollout share in percent.
- [e007] In the decision log, Bo wrote down that the reason for the decision on the mobile CI service is `why-team-skill`.
- [e008] In the decision log, Femi wrote down that the reason for the decision on the staged rollout tool is `why-review-time`.
- [e009] The minutes by Pita give the motive of the choice, so the reason for the decision on the code signing method is `why-privacy`.
- [e010] The minutes by Quinn give the motive of the choice, so the reason for the decision on the beta channel is `why-crash-rate`.
- [e011] In the call with the user, Ivo noted that the status of the constraint cn-keep-min-os is `in-force` from now on.
- [e012] In the call with the user, Hana noted that the status of the constraint cn-no-tracking is `in-force` from now on.
- [e013] In the review, Sami recorded that the answer to the open question oq-min-ios is `still-open`.
- [e014] In the review, Dara recorded that the answer to the open question oq-hotfix-owner is `still-open`.
- [e015] Ivo brought the question to the meeting, and the answer to the open question oq-store-copy is `still-open` for now.
- [e016] In the review, Pita recorded that the answer to the open question oq-beta-size is `still-open`.
- [e017] Jun brought the question to the meeting, and the answer to the open question oq-dark-icons is `still-open` for now.

Rules for this task:
- A value changes only by an event that decides, answers, corrects, assigns, links or reviews it. A proposal with no decision, a withdrawn draft, a question, a link to a page and an archived copy change nothing.
- A correction or a new entry replaces the earlier value. The earlier value is then superseded.
- The initial specification gives the first value of each item.
- A question about the values of an item "at some point" counts every value from the initial specification on, up to the time of the question. The value "directly before" the current value is the value that the current value replaced.
- Some decisions have a recorded reason. The closed list of reason ids is `why-crash-rate`, `why-review-time`, `why-team-skill`, `why-sdk-size`, `why-pricing`, `why-privacy`.
- Each decision with a recorded reason has one reason at a time. An entry that records a reason for it replaces the earlier reason. A later entry can replace the reason and keep the decision. A new decision with no such entry keeps the earlier reason.
- The user sets constraints and can lift them later. A constraint is `in-force` or `lifted`.
- An open question has the answer `still-open` until an entry answers it. A later entry can replace an answer.
Every event has a label of the form [eNNN] with a three-digit number. A higher number is later in time. A later event can change or cancel an earlier one.
Some material quotes old pages or copies for history. A quote of that kind is not a new statement.
